mapper.select: SELECT RR.RSRV_ID, RR.CONF_RM_ID, RR.RSRV_EMP_ID, RR.RSRV_PURPS, RR.BEGIN_DT, RR.END_DT, RR.DEL_YN, RR.INTG_RSRV_YN, E.EMP_NM AS RSRV_EMP_NM, E.DEPT_CD AS RSRV_EMP_DEPT_CD, E.JOB_GRD_CD AS RSRV_EMP_JOB_GRD_CD, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID AS RSRV_EMP_PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, M.MTNG_ID AS MTNG_ID FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV RR JOIN TB_CONF_RM CR ON RR.CONF_RM_ID = CR.CONF_RM_ID JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON RR.RSRV_EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG M ON M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID = RR.RSRV_ID AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE CR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND RR.DEL_YN = 'N' AND RR.BEGIN_DT <= #{endDt} AND RR.END_DT >= #{beginDt} ORDER BY RR.CONF_RM_ID, RR.BEGIN_DT

SELECT RR.RSRV_ID, RR.CONF_RM_ID, RR.RSRV_EMP_ID, RR.RSRV_PURPS, RR.BEGIN_DT, RR.END_DT, RR.DEL_YN, RR.INTG_RSRV_YN, E.EMP_NM AS RSRV_EMP_NM, E.DEPT_CD AS RSRV_EMP_DEPT_CD, E.JOB_GRD_CD AS RSRV_EMP_JOB_GRD_CD, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID AS RSRV_EMP_PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV RR JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON RR.RSRV_EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG M ON M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID = RR.RSRV_ID AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE RR.RSRV_ID = #{rsrvId} AND RR.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONF_RM_RSRV SET RSRV_PURPS = #{rsrvPurps}, BEGIN_DT = #{beginDt}, END_DT = #{endDt}, INTG_RSRV_YN = #{intgRsrvYn} WHERE RSRV_ID = #{rsrvId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RR.RSRV_ID, RR.CONF_RM_ID, RR.RSRV_EMP_ID, RR.RSRV_PURPS, RR.BEGIN_DT, RR.END_DT, RR.INTG_RSRV_YN, M.MTNG_ID FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV RR JOIN TB_CONF_RM CR ON RR.CONF_RM_ID = CR.CONF_RM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG M ON M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID = RR.RSRV_ID AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE CR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND RR.DEL_YN = 'N' AND RR.RSRV_EMP_ID = #{empId} AND RR.BEGIN_DT >= #{beginDt} AND RR.BEGIN_DT <= #{endDt} ORDER BY RR.BEGIN_DT ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
